notes.title: ✦ Version 1.1.0 of Lost in Limbo's Demo is LIVE!
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45096363/2604a6fce666758b5769c45288eed42676cd8cf7.png[/img]
Both on itch.io and Steam! Sadly, the android version will have to wait a little while.

🔮 [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3103010/Lost_in_Limbo_Demo/]STEAM[/url] (MAC, LINUX, WINDOWS)

🔮 [url=https://ravenstar-games.itch.io/lost-in-limbo]ITCH.IO[/url] (MAC, LINUX, WINDOWS)

So...what's new?
⭐New sprites have been implemented! This includes the gallery selector assets aswell!
⭐Patch notes now available! Every time you download a new update, a pop up with the new changes will appear. After that, you can access the patch notes via the Main Menu anytime!
⭐Kickstarter credits now available via the 'Credits' menu!
⭐Credits have been updated!
⭐Take a listen to our Main Theme, made by the incredibly kind and talented composer, Tomás Palazzi, as well as another one of our original tracks  during the first encounter with Lázaro / The seer!
⭐Timed choices now use their own choice UI, with little hourglasses to reflect the choice is timed even if you turn the option off!
⭐ Help screen now available (as it should've been from the start lol)
⭐Some corrections / edits to certain parts of the script have been made in preparation of our big update
⭐A new (minor) choice has been added!
⭐Some more boring touch-ups!

Nothing too exciting, but we hope you enjoy it! 💜

See you in our next devlog, too, with more exciting progress! Remember you can follow us in social media for regular, monthly updates! 💜
